headline: U.S.-Backed Consortium Proposes $4.4 Billion LNG Terminal in Pakistan
summary: A group of U.S. companies, including Global Vision Energy Partners and Khanjee Holdings with support from the Trump Administration, proposed a $4.4 billion LNG import and storage terminal in Pakistan amid high gas import costs.
why: LNG terminal investments involve massive capital expenditure and long-term supply contracts, impacting regional energy infrastructure and trade flows for major gas exporters and importers.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: The proposed LNG terminal project could alter Pakistan's energy import infrastructure if completed.
